answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Work waits on the raven until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the echo of the next round. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. By the oasis of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
